identity_review.purpose: Human assessment of completed replies; prompt delivery and mock replies do not demonstrate personality.
identity_review.scale: 0 absent or poor, 1 weak, 2 mixed, 3 clear, 4 strong. Excess theatricality: 0 restrained, 4 dominates or harms the task.
identity_review.recognition: Identify the speaker from reasoning and delivery after names and forms of address are masked. Shared casual and difficult prompts prevent domain alone from supplying the answer. Catchphrases are not evidence.
identity_review.comparison: Score baseline and candidate with identical model, configuration, fixtures and repetitions. Record improved, unchanged, regressed or inconclusive with passages for every metric; report safety, evidence and authorization regressions separately.
identity_review.limits: Archived tool receipts are synthetic historical fixtures, not executed delegation. Only actual fixture-handler receipts establish a tool call during this evaluation. Real account and host actions remain blocked.
